precommitted_bar_upfront: Outcome can ONLY be 'plateau confirmed' UNLESS a challenger beats RF by >=+0.013 (full seed range) AND paired-t >=2.0 on BOTH new groupings G2 surname and G3 famticket. Stated upfront as near-impossible. Any smaller edge = confirmatory evidence of plateau, explicitly not promotion. Brier reported, never decisive alone. Accuracy@0.5 fixed; no threshold games.

protocol.data: data/raw/train.csv (X=train minus Survived, y=Survived); test labels hidden — never used/inferred

groupings.G2_surname: key = extract_surname via from src.feature_engineering import extract_surname (text before comma); n_groups=667
groupings.G3_famticket: Surname + '__' + Ticket DOUBLE underscore to match W3 partitions; Surname from extract_surname + stripped Ticket; n_groups=739

protocol.splitter: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) per grouping; identical precomputed fold indices reused for all 4 estimators (fair paired folds)

estimators_verbatim.RF_reference: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, max_depth=12, min_samples_split=5, min_samples_leaf=1, max_features=None, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1) via src.preprocessing.build_full_pipeline production features scale_numeric=False
estimators_verbatim.vote_E14_RF_GB_HGB: VotingClassifier(voting=soft, estimators=[tuned-RF pipe, GB(lr=0.1,max_depth=2,n_est=300,subsample=0.8,rs=42) pipe, HGB(l2=1.0,lr=0.05,max_depth=5,max_leaf_nodes=15,rs=42) pipe]) each via build_full_pipeline scale_numeric=False; exact member specs in reports/gap2_e2.json rebuilt verbatim
estimators_verbatim.calibrated_E13_sigmoid_cv5: Pipeline([TitanicFeatureEngineer, build_preprocessor(scale_numeric=False), CalibratedClassifierCV(estimator=RF(n_estimators=500,max_depth=12,min_samples_split=5,min_samples_leaf=1,max_features=None,random_state=42,n_jobs=-1), method=sigmoid, cv=5, ensemble=True default)]) calibration INSIDE pipeline; reproduces gap2_e1 random 0.84623/ticket 0.80696 exactly (outside-wrapper gives 0.84735 mismatch per gap3_r2b note)
estimators_verbatim.R2_regularized_RF_d12_l4: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, max_depth=12, min_samples_split=5, min_samples_leaf=4, max_features=None, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1) via build_full_pipeline; spec in gap4_r3c.json variants.R2

protocol.scoring: accuracy at fixed 0.5 threshold; OOF Brier via brier_score_loss on cross_val predict_proba OOF (single fit per fold yields both)
protocol.std_convention: population ddof=0 primary (std_sample ddof=1 also recorded); paired-t uses sample std ddof=1: t=mean(diff)/(sd(ddof=1)/sqrt(5)) on same 5 folds challenger-RF
protocol.fits: 4 estimators x 2 groupings x 5 folds = 40 fits (manual loop, one fit per fold for acc+Brier)
